dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: I understand there was a fainting episode. Can you tell me what you remember?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: I was standing in the kitchen yesterday when I suddenly became very dizzy. The next thing I remember is sitting on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: I was there. He suddenly went pale and collapsed. He was unconscious for about ten seconds.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Did he hit his head when he fell?

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: No. I managed to catch him partly, so his head did not hit the floor.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Had you eaten normally before this happened?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Not really. I skipped breakfast and had only a small sandwich during the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: He has been working long hours recently and has not been eating properly.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Did you have chest pain or feel your heart racing before you fainted?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No chest pain. I mainly remember feeling hot and dizzy just before everything went dark.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: I will check your heart rate and blood pressure and perform some additional tests today.
